verdict.rationale: Insomnia supports pre-request/after-response scripting and chaining requests to build test workflows, and Inso CLI automates test execution in CI, implying assertion-based testing against responses; however, the evidence never explicitly shows syntax or examples for asserting on status codes, body content, or headers specifically. missing for 10: explicit documentation/examples of assertion syntax for status/body/headers, independent/hands-on confirmation that these assertions work as described.
